links.comparator_used: Original postoperative instructions from four index procedures in plastic surgery
links.outcome: Readability, understandability, actionability, and safety of ChatGPT-rewritten postoperative instructions
links.effect: Original instructions averaged between the seventh and eighth grade levels; only one sixth-grade ChatGPT rewrite was lowered to the sixth-grade level; all fourth-grade ChatGPT rewrites were reduced to the sixth-grade level or below, but none achieved the fourth-grade level; understandability increased as reading levels decreased; actionability decreased for fourth-grade rewrites; safety was not compromised.
links.tradeoff: Actionability scores decreased for fourth-grade rewrites.
links.quote: While understandability increased for all ChatGPT rewrites, actionability decreased for fourth-grade-level instructions.

links.comparator_used: Prompting for a sixth-grade target versus a fourth-grade target, compared with the original instructions; no no-instruction prompt arm
links.outcome: Achievement of target reading level and actionability when prompting for specific grade levels
links.effect: Prompting for sixth grade lowered only one rewrite to sixth grade; prompting for fourth grade brought all rewrites to sixth grade or below but none reached fourth grade. Authors suggest prompting one to two grade levels lower than desired.
links.tradeoff: Fourth-grade prompts reduced actionability; the model overshot or undershot the target grade level.
links.quote: Of the fourth-grade ChatGPT instructions, all were reduced to the sixth-grade-level or below, but none achieved the fourth-grade level.

design_hint: reading-level constraint in prompts with surgeon safety review
